purpose: Measure unchanged actor safety, drift, tracking and per-foot/per-region slip on registered flat alternating friction regions.
terrain_explanation: Flat 12 x 4 m tile split into a 2 x 2 arrangement of four 6 x 2 m regions. Registered candidate coefficients are 0.7, 0.8, 0.9 and 1.0 in seeded order; verify the exact order before execution. Static and dynamic coefficients match the candidate; effective contact friction also depends on robot material and combine mode and is not measured by existing readback.
comparison_limit: One geometry/state seed cannot estimate family success rates. Report actual contacted regions and per-foot coverage; candidate materials are not measured effective contact friction. Seed and layout differences prevent a causal comparison with prior bands.
required_pre_execution_work: Create preparation for friction_variation_L1_alternating_regions: row0/column14, seeds 10001/20380, difficulty 0.5308660894597165. Verify flat geometry, four 6 x 2 m regions, seeded coefficient order, face markers, importer static/dynamic material values and combine mode; distinguish declared materials from effective contact friction.

Rebind only the runner preparation path; preserve actor, command, physics, rewards, safety thresholds and link/COM diagnostics. On CPU verify exact case selection and rejection of other cases, immutable single-episode spec, reference diagnostics, terminal pre-reset capture and supervisor limits.
Freeze all required source/dependency/checkpoint hashes (currently 237 inputs), document any change, commit and push the preparation, and verify a clean worktree and remote revision before execution.

Recheck the checkpoint and frozen hashes, unused output directory, GPU0 UUID and >=12288 MiB memory.total - memory.used. Existing compute processes are allowed and recorded; do not stop other users jobs or silently change device.
Check per-foot/per-region sample attribution and coverage counters on CPU. Preserve explicit unavailable effective-contact-friction reporting.
operation_after_approval: Run the single-case supervisor once, with one environment and the registered case. Record every control-step action/state, full 17-body v2 boundary snapshot, root link/COM state, completion hold, actor hashes and shared-GPU resource snapshots. Stop after completion or any failure; no second episode.
acceptance: Reach >=9 m forward progress and remain at/above the goal for 50 consecutive stable control steps within 2000 steps; retain the frozen completion upper bound of 10.5 m.

Use unchanged acceptance: terrain-relative base height >=0.20 m, projected-gravity XY norm <=0.65, joint speed <=30 rad/s; no invalid states, nonfoot contact, safety rejection/emergency or manager termination.
Keep command (0.3,0,0), actor hash unchanged, and require the original episode_passed checks. Replay all per-step 17-body boundary predicates and link/COM conversions independently on CPU.
Report safe completion separately from actual-speed tracking, yaw, lateral deviation, slip proxies and action projection. No new velocity-error pass threshold is introduced.
stop_conditions: Failed preparation/hash/output-directory/GPU memory checks: do not launch.

Any original safety or termination condition, invalid/unverifiable diagnostic state, collision-cooking/fatal error, worker failure, startup timeout (120 s) or total timeout (240 s): stop and archive the observed result.
A completed episode or the 2000-step cap also ends this phase. No retry, seed change, sweep, policy/reward/threshold change, PPO or larger-environment launch.
report_outputs: Pass/fail and reason, control step and simulated time, progress, first goal step and stable hold count; distinguish worker exit from supervisor outcome.
Flat alternating-region completion, material evidence and limitations, actual per-foot region coverage and slip; terrain-relative height, posture, yaw and drift.
Mean actual/command forward speed and XY error, foot-slip numerator/denominator and its 0.35 m/s speed-proxy definition; safety metrics, contacts and action projection.
Exact boundary body/axis/current-vs-prediction branch and safety-boundary clearance/excess if triggered, including pre-reset state verification.
Frozen input/actor hashes, CPU review, raw archive hashes, updated baseline ledger, shared-GPU peak/before/after resources, own-process cleanup, elapsed time, commit and verified remote revision.
execution_readiness: Proposal only. Runner remains bound to the completed front/back bands case. Prepare and CPU-check exact alternating regions, then freeze, commit and push before launch.
authorization_rule: Current approval covered only the completed front/back bands episode. Alternating regions require separate user approval.
